blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Government employees here may not receive the full ₱25,000 Christmas incentive announced by Mayor Nestor Archival. The proposed ₱20,000 Service Recognition Incentive (SRI) still requires national guidelines and approval, while only the remaining ₱5,000 has already been secured in the city’s 2026 annual budget. Councilor Dave Tumulak, chairman of the City Council’s Committee on Budget and Finance, said the city government must first verify the proposed SRI’s funding source and check the Department of Budget and Management’s (DBM) guidelines before proceeding with the incentive.
